AGENDA
  ALHAMBRA YOUTH COMMISSION
  REGULAR MEETING
  Alhambra Public Library, Learning Center - 101 S. First Street, Alhambra, CA 91801
  Tuesday, May 14, 2024 - 6:00 PM

Commissioners  Members Ex Officio
Daniela Andrade  Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation
Joselyn Cooper  Brie Houghton, Deputy Director
Marilyn Gonzalez  Rosalyn Rojas, Recreation Supervisor
Arabella Hernandez
Isabella Hernandez
Tatiana Hernandez
Iren Lam
Jason Quach
Natalia Rosales
Andy Tiang
Chen Yu

We welcome you to the Youth Commission meeting.
If you wish to address the Commission during the meeting, please complete a speaker’s card and give it to
the secretary. The maximum time for addressing the Commission is five minutes. If you wish to address
the Commission on an item that appears on the agenda, your comments will be heard during the
Commission’s discussion of that item. If you wish to address the Commission on a subject that does not
appear on the agenda but is related to recreation or community service, you may make your presentation
under agenda item VII. Please be advised that the Commission cannot, under the State of California’s
Ralph M. Brown Act, take action on any item that does not appear on the agenda.
When making your presentation, please give your name and address for the record. Please make your
statement as brief as possible. Thank you.

Copies of staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business described
hereinabove are on file in the Department of Parks & Recreation, Alhambra City Hall, 111 South First
Street, Alhambra, California, and are available for public inspection during regular office hours which are
7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Monday through Thursday.
Should any person have a question concerning any of the above agenda items prior to the meeting
described herein, he or she may contact Mr. Michael Macias, Director of Parks & Recreation, either in
person at the Department of Parks & Recreation or by telephone at
626-570-5044.
